mostWorthwhile.text: Measuring each operating radio against its reserve's usable capacity and starting charge made the overnight claim concrete, rather than assuming that battery power alone was enough.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two failed meter attempts were repetitive, and the missing prerequisite was not clear until I inspected the mounted radios.

surprise.text: The meter could not be used even after the radios were mounted; they first needed to be connected and powered.

arbitrary.text: The meter's unavailable state felt opaque at first, although measuring the operating, battery-powered link ultimately made sense.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighborhoods make their networks understand each other, especially after the practical work of establishing and testing this link.
